### Fixed

- (muster) [Open the sign-in dialog only from a person's action](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3497) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Since v3.36.0, the dialog asking to open a connector's sign-in page kept popping up while pages loaded. It now opens only after you click, e.g. a tool's `Run`; pages show their `Sign in` button instead, or `Cannot sign in` with muster's reason.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.38.4...v3.38.5
